headline: Can Fin Homes posts better-than-expected quarterly profit

Retail investors tracking housing finance stocks should note the steady earnings growth amid a challenging stock price trend.

headline: Can Fin Homes Q2 profit rises 10% to Rs 275 crore
hook: Double-digit profit growth for Can Fin Homes
summary: Can Fin Homes reported a 10% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 275 crore for the second quarter of FY27. The company's net interest income grew by 7%, while its total loan book expanded by 10% to Rs 43,539 crore. Shares of the housing finance firm rose by 5% following the announcement of these quarterly results.
why_it_matters: Stronger earnings may support current stock price momentum for shareholders.
